title: Judge Idiom Court
description: Preside over an ancient magistrate courtroom—link intersecting Chinese idioms to uncover evidence, interrogate culprits, and earn promotions.
controls: Tap character tiles at the bottom to fill blanks on the idiom grid and advance through courtroom cases.

zh-CN.title: 请老爷断案
zh-CN.description: 国风成语升官爆款请老爷断案：填字连成语步步查明奇案真相，升官发财买豪宅，玩着就把成语库刷满！
zh-CN.controls: 点击下方候选汉字填入空白格子组成正确成语，连词通关断案升官。
